auth.note: Nothing publishes until the quality gate has read it.

signIn.title: Your queue kept <accent>filling</accent> itself.
signIn.blurb: Autopilot does not wait for you to log in. Anything it wrote while you were away is in the pipeline, already through the quality gate.
signIn.footer: No account yet? <link>Start with your website</link>

signUp.title: Give it your website. <accent>Keep</accent> the rest of your day.
signUp.blurb: One URL is all it needs. Contivo reads your site into a brand memory, maps the competitors you actually have, and only then starts writing.
signUp.fineprint: Free while Contivo is in early access. No card, and nothing publishes anywhere until you connect a channel yourself.
